WITH subscriptions AS (
  SELECT
    subscription_id,
    user_id,
    started_date::DATE AS started_date,
    -- treat open-ended ended_date as today for duration; if ended_date is NULL and is_active=1, use current_date
    COALESCE(ended_date::DATE, current_date) AS ended_date,
    billed_amount
  FROM fct_subscriptions
),
subscription_durations AS (
  SELECT
    subscription_id,
    user_id,
    billed_amount,
    -- DuckDB supports date subtraction returning integer days
    (ended_date - started_date) + 1 AS duration_days,
    -- approximate lifetime in months as days / 30.0
    ((ended_date - started_date) + 1) / 30.0 AS duration_months,
    -- lifetime value per subscription = billed_amount * duration_months
    billed_amount * ( ((ended_date - started_date) + 1) / 30.0 ) AS lifetime_value
  FROM subscriptions
  WHERE started_date IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS subscriptions_count,
    SUM(lifetime_value) AS total_ltv
  FROM subscription_durations
)
SELECT
  -- one row: the average lifetime value (in currency units) across all subscriptions
  total_ltv / nullif(subscriptions_count,0) AS average_lifetime_value
FROM agg;
